posts.text: The Trump administration has indicated that it will keep the $70 million luxury jet that Kristi Noem purchased for use by Melania Trump and other senior staff. The luxury Boeing 737 includes a queen size bed, a cocktail bar, and multiple large screen TVs.

Vice President JD Vance says that Iran misunderstood the terms of the ceasefire and that the agreement never included Lebanon.  However, Pakistan’s Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif posted about it shortly after the agreement was finalized and included the Trump top cabinet in the communication.

Did ICE and DHS find 3300 missing children during their immigration enforcement operations in Minnesota? People like @🇺🇸2guys1coup🇺🇸 seem to think that, but the truth is that ICE and the federal government simply updated their address with the court system. They were not missing.

Secretary of defense, Pete Hegseth said that the first message that the US air force pilot who was downed in Iran sent through his transponder was “God is good“.  unless the transponder was pre-programmed with that message, that would be impossible.

President Trump said that the United States government cannot take care of daycare costs for the American families because of the high cost of the Iran war.  Trump also said that America’s spending priorities should be in the military.  in 2024, when asked about daycare costs, Trump had pledged that he would push legislation that would help families with daycare costs

What does the 25th amendment do? Trump, the war in Iran and the President’s ultimatum and deadline are coming to a head.  And if you think the 25th Amendment is an easy solution, you should think again…

Should food be a human right? Food is an essential part of life. It should be a human right. The United States voted a U.N. resolution to make food a human right, and people like @Patriotic Peach celebrated that failure because they are convinced that making food a human right would require forcing people to produce it. Let’s fact check that logic.  #humanrights #foodinsecurity

During a press conference, Donald Trump said that he wants his legacy to be that of a great peacemaker. He also said that he thinks of himself as a great peacemaker.  Trump made those statements as the war against Iran continues without a clear end in sight.

Houston’s George Bush Airport opened a prayer room catering to Muslim travelers, which includes prayer rugs, a copy of the Quran, and a washing station.  Atlanta airport now offers one prayer a week for Muslim passengers.  And people like toribranum are losing their mind over this because the faith and religion does not meet their expectations.  Is this what tolerance in America looks like?

Victor J Glover, the pilot of the Artemis II, is being celebrated as the first Black American on a moon mission.  But people like @Grace Unfiltered think that we need to stop celebrating Black achievements. The reason we have to celebrate the achievements of Black Americans is because the system is designed to make it more difficult for People of Color to win or even compete in certain areas.  Equity is also about celebrating victories.
